modelReview.summary: The analysis lacks fundamental design details, predictor definition, and proper performance reporting. It is exploratory and unbound. Cannot support any claims.

findings.title: Missing essential study design elements
findings.whyItMatters: Without description of population, setting, outcome, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and predictor origins, the analysis is uninterpretable and unreproducible.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a full study protocol detailing data source, cohort construction, variable definitions, and predictor derivation.

findings.title: Undefined predictor 'pred_score'
findings.whyItMatters: Without knowing how pred_score was generated (e.g., which model, trained on what data, potential for overfitting), the validity of performance metrics cannot be assessed.
findings.actionableFix: Document the predictor: was it from an existing risk score, a model trained on the same data, or external? Provide derivation details.

findings.title: Confidence intervals missing for AUROC and Brier score
findings.whyItMatters: Point estimates without uncertainty measures do not allow assessment of precision; alpha=0.05 was specified but not used.
findings.actionableFix: Compute and report 95% confidence intervals (e.g., DeLong for AUROC, bootstrap for Brier) in the results.

findings.title: No calibration assessment for prediction model
findings.whyItMatters: Good discrimination does not guarantee calibration; miscalibration can lead to poor clinical decisions. Brier score alone is not sufficient.
findings.actionableFix: Produce calibration plot (predicted vs observed), report calibration-in-the-large and calibration slope, and consider Hosmer-Lemeshow test.

findings.title: Complete-case analysis without missing data documentation
findings.whyItMatters: Missing data can bias results if not missing completely at random. No information on how many records were excluded or the reasons.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number of cases with missing data, compare complete vs incomplete cases, and consider sensitivity analyses (e.g., multiple imputation).

findings.title: Analysis is unbound and lacks pre-specification
findings.whyItMatters: Without protocol binding, results are exploratory and cannot be interpreted as confirmatory; the 'prespecified study question' claim is unsupported.
findings.actionableFix: Create an AnalysisSpec (pre-specified analysis plan) and bind the run to it. Re-run or review for consistency.

findings.title: Incomplete reporting of QA warnings
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript mentions 'advisory issues' vaguely; readers cannot assess the severity of the quality checks.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state that the run is unbound and exploratory, and list the specific QA warning details.

findings.title: Outcome prevalence not reported
findings.whyItMatters: The Brier score is prevalence-dependent; without knowing event rate, its value (0.1925) is hard to interpret.
findings.actionableFix: Report the proportion of positive outcomes in the dataset.
